lines.en: label toukaspring2:
I’m not sure why she smirks at me when we both know she isn’t actually going to make me do anything. That’s just not the type of person she is.
lines.zh: 我不懂她为什么对我坏笑——我们俩都清楚，她其实不会真逼我做什么。她不是那种人。

lines.en: And that’s likely part of why she’s cemented herself as such a subtly pivotal figure in this endlessly confused half-life of mine.
lines.zh: 而这大概也是她能在我这团乱麻的「半条命」里，稳稳站住一个微妙关键位置的部分原因。

lines.en: scene nightsky
I’m sure I’m not the only one around here who’s “confused,” though. And I need to stop putting myself into a bubble that prevents me from actually caring about that.
lines.zh: 不过我肯定不是这儿唯一「乱」的人。我得停止把自己关在泡泡里，免得我真的对别人的感受无动于衷。

lines.en: Touka Tsukioka is a girl. Not a woman. Not a mother. She’s a girl. Plain and simple.
lines.zh: Touka Tsukioka 是个女孩。不是女人。不是母亲。就是个女孩。就这么简单。

lines.en: But this causes complications for me because it turns her into something I don’t want her to be. And accepting that truth brings me closer to making one more mistake and losing one more piece of myself.
lines.zh: 可这给我添了麻烦，因为这把她变成了我不希望她成为的样子。而接受这个事实，会让我离「再犯一个错、再丢掉一块自己」更近一步。

lines.en: Maybe it’d be okay if she gave me a piece of her as well, though.
lines.zh: 不过，要是她也肯分我一块「她」，或许就没关系了。

lines.en: I’ve told myself I shouldn’t care. That I’d given up on finding happiness and that I’d settle for reverting to the real me — a man who fucks those he shouldn’t and forgets those he should.
lines.zh: 我告诉自己不该在乎。告诉自己早就放弃追求幸福、甘心退回那个真实的我——一个睡了不该睡的人、忘了不该忘的人的男人。

lines.en: So what am I doing pretending roles like “matriarch” even matter to me at this point?
lines.zh: 那我这会儿干嘛还假装「女家长」这种角色对我有什么意义？

lines.en: What am I doing not trying to fuck her when she fits the criteria of everyone else I’ve corrupted almost perfectly?
lines.zh: 她几乎完美符合我祸害过的其他所有人的标准，我干嘛不干脆睡了她？

lines.en: Am I just fooling myself? Because my body most certainly wants her. It’s only my mind that doesn’t.
lines.zh: 我只是在自欺欺人吗？因为我的身体确实想要她。只有我的脑子不想。

lines.en: But I’ve never trusted that part of myself before. And I definitely don’t think I should start doing that now that it’s clearly gotten worse..
lines.zh: 可我从来没信过自己那部分。而且现在它明显变得更糟了，我绝对不该开始信它。

lines.en: Is all of this just a clever way of convincing my brain to dwell less on the past and more on the future since I know at least that will never leave me behind?
lines.zh: 这一切，会不会只是个巧妙的办法，好让我的脑子少惦记过去、多想点未来——因为我知道，至少「未来」永远不会抛下我？

lines.en: Or is she closer to resembling something even more forbidden than the youngest fruit that fell from the same tree?
lines.zh: 又或者，她更像某种比「同一棵树上结出的最嫩的果子」还要禁忌的东西？

lines.en: Whatever she is, it scares me...because it makes me doubt myself. And that scares me even more because my first instinct is to wrap myself up in her to find comfort.
lines.zh: 不管她是什么，都让我害怕……因为它让我怀疑自己。而这更让我害怕，因为我的第一反应竟是把自己裹进她怀里去找安慰。

lines.en: It’s an endless cycle of fear and love, spearheaded by a girl who doesn’t even know the power she wields.
lines.zh: 这是一个由恐惧和爱组成的死循环，而带头的是一个根本不知道自己握有多大权力的女孩。

lines.en: Or maybe she does and she’s just like me — denying it because it’s complicated and conflicts with what her heart craves.
lines.zh: 又或者她知道，只是跟我一样——因为这事太复杂、又跟她内心的渴望冲突，所以选择了否认。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor1
We wind up back at the manor somehow. I don’t know. I spent so much time trying to argue away my erection that I must have blurred out everything that happened after lunch.
lines.zh: 不知怎么，我们最后回到了大宅。我不知道。我花了太多时间跟自己的勃起较劲，午饭后发生的一切肯定都被我过滤掉了。

lines.en: I’m sure it went well. And I’m sure Touka enjoyed herself if she was willing to take me back home after it all played out.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定进展顺利。而且 Touka 既然肯把我带回她家，那她肯定玩得挺开心。

lines.en: But I also know that this is typically the part of a “date” where one invites the other up for tea or coffee before clothes start to come off and poor decisions start to be made.
lines.zh: 但我也知道，一场「约会」到了这个节点，通常是一方邀另一方上楼喝茶或咖啡，然后衣服开始往下掉、糟糕的决定开始往外冒。

lines.en: It’s the perfect moment to figure out whether she really is important to me in a way that separates her from the rest.
lines.zh: 这正是弄清「她对我是否真的重要到与众不同」的完美时机。

lines.en: But I don’t like “perfect” moments.
lines.zh: 可我不喜欢「完美」的时机。

lines.en: So I hope that she ruins it.
lines.zh: 所以我希望她能把它搅黄。

lines.en: : Is something the matter, Sensei? You’ve been rather quiet since we entered the manor.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sensei？进宅子之后你就一直很安静。

lines.en: : Yeah well, one wrong move here and someone could slit my throat.
lines.zh: : 是啊，毕竟在这儿走错一步，就可能有人割我喉咙。

lines.en: : I doubt anyone would do that while I’m in such close proximity to you. Dirtying my clothes would be greatly frowned upon.
lines.zh: : 我敢说你跟我贴这么近的时候，没人敢那么做。弄脏我的衣服可是要遭人白眼的。

lines.en: : Then be sure to stay close so I can make it home after this.
lines.zh: : 那你可得一直贴近点，好让我完事之后能活着回家。

lines.en: : And to which home will you be returning today? The one with your niece who is in love with you? Or the one with your girlfriend who is in love with you?
lines.zh: : 那你今天回哪个家？回那个住着暗恋你的侄女的家？还是回那个住着暗恋你的女朋友的家？

lines.en: : Or one of your girlfriends, I suppose. I’m not quite sure how many you have, come to think of it. But I do know that it’s more than I’d personally recommend.
lines.zh: : 或者说，你的「女朋友之一」。说起来我也不太确定你到底有几个。但我知道，肯定比我个人推荐的多。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor2
: And I’m sure you’d recommend only one, correct? You don’t strike me as a polyamorist.
lines.zh: : 而我猜你只推荐一个，对吧？你不像是个「多元恋爱」派。

lines.en: : One would be ideal, yes. But it isn’t uncommon for those in my echelon to take a mistress as well.
lines.zh: : 一个最理想，没错。不过我这一层的人纳个妾，也不算稀奇。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor3
: Of course, that only goes for the men. Us women aren’t typically awarded the same level of freedom. Which isn’t to say I’d do such a thing anyway. I just figured I’d share.
lines.zh: : 当然，那只对男人成立。我们女人通常得不到同等的自由。倒不是说我会那么干。我只是随口一说。

lines.en: : Thanks for the info. But you’re a girl, not a woman.
lines.zh: : 多谢科普。不过你是女孩，不是女人。

lines.en: : Some might disagree, Sensei. You’ve noted on many occasions just how much more mature I am than the rest of the girls in our class, have you not?
lines.zh: : 有人可不这么看，Sensei。你不是好几次都夸我比班上其他女孩成熟得多吗？

lines.en: : Are you trying to tell me something right now, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你这话是想暗示我什么吗，Touka？

lines.en: : Is there something you’d like me to tell you?
lines.zh: : 你希望我暗示你点什么吗？

lines.en: : No, actually.
lines.zh: : 不，不想。

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 不想？

lines.en: : Right. It’s already wrong of me to have followed you all the way to what I can only imagine is one of thirty bedrooms you have.
lines.zh: : 对。我跟着你一路走到这儿——我猜这是你三十间卧室里的一间——本来就是我不对。

lines.en: : Yet here you are. And here I want you to be.
lines.zh: : 可你还是来了。而我正希望你待在这儿。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : Would you perhaps like to see a tour of-
lines.zh: : 你大概想不想参观一下——

lines.en: scene returntothemanor4
: Oh my! If it isn’t my eldest daughter and her “former” teacher.
lines.zh: : 哎呀！这不是我的大女儿和她的「前」老师嘛。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor5
: Aaaand of course my mother is here.
lines.zh: : 然——后，我妈果然在这儿。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor6
: How unexpected. I’d known the two of you ran off somewhere, but if I had any idea that you’d be returning together, I’d have had dinner prepared for you.
lines.zh: : 真意外。早知道你们俩跑出去了，可我要是早知道你们会一起回来，就让人备好晚饭了。

lines.en: : We already ate. But thank you, Mother. And thank you for keeping tabs on my every move as well. It’s good to know that I am always being watched.
lines.zh: : 我们吃过了。不过还是谢谢你，母亲。也谢谢你一直盯着我的一举一动。知道自己时刻被监视，真好。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor7
: Or perhaps your teacher is the one I’m keeping tabs on and you just happened to be there with him?
lines.zh: : 又或许，我盯的是你的老师，而你只是恰好跟他在一起？

lines.en: : Yeah, I wouldn’t put that past you.
lines.zh: : 对，你干得出这种事。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor8
: Hahah! Hilarious as ever! Oh, how I enjoy that blunt sense of humor of yours.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！还是这么搞笑！哦，我可真喜欢你这股子直来直去的幽默劲。

lines.en: : Ahem.
scene returntothemanor9
: What’s wrong, dear? You’re not coming down with a cold, are you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，亲爱的？你该不会着凉了吧？

lines.en: : No, Mother...I was just in the middle of a conversation.
lines.zh: : 没有，母亲……我刚才正跟人聊天呢。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh, good! Then surely you won’t mind if I join you for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 哦，那正好！那你肯定不介意我加入你们聊几分钟。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Don’t worry, darling. I was just on my way to the sauna, so you aren’t interrupting anything.
lines.zh: : 别担心，亲爱的。我正要去桑拿，所以你们没打扰到我。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor10
: That’s...not what I was trying to imply...
lines.zh: : 我……不是那个意思……

lines.en: : Oh? Am I perhaps...interrupting something?
lines.zh: : 哦？难不成是我……打扰到你们了？

lines.en: : It is rather late to be receiving lessons, isn’t it? Let alone lessons from a former teacher. Unless something has changed, of course.
lines.zh: : 这会儿「上课」是不是太晚了点？何况还是「前」老师的课。除非情况有变。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor11
: Hah...I was just giving Sensei a tour of the central pavilion. I can assure you it was nothing out of the ordinary.
lines.zh: : 哈……我只是带 Sensei 参观一下中央主厅。我向你保证，没什么出格的。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor12
: Nonsense. What are your intentions with my daughter?
lines.zh: : 胡说。你对我女儿有什么企图？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor13
: Mother!
lines.zh: : 母亲！

lines.en: : Hahah! Oh, I’ve always wanted to say that. I’m so funny.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！哦，我一直想说这句。我可真逗。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor14
: The funniest, truly...
lines.zh: : 真的，最逗的就是你……

lines.en: : Intimidating as ever too.
lines.zh: : 也还是那么有威慑力。

lines.en: : What reason is there to be intimidated? You’ve already made it quite clear to me that you have no such intentions with Touka. What with seeing her more as a “mother figure” and all. Correct?
lines.zh: : 有什么好怕的？你不是早就跟我说得很清楚，你对 Touka 没那种企图吗？毕竟你把她当「母亲般的长辈」看。对吧？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor15
: I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Hah...
: You must be misunderstanding something, Mother. We’ve had a legitimate competition in regard to that topic, and I lost.
lines.zh: : 你一定是误会了什么，母亲。我们就那个话题正经比过一场，而我输了。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m merely half of Sensei’s age. He wouldn’t possibly view me in such a way. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 再说，我只有 Sensei 一半的年纪。他不可能那样看我。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor16
: Why do you do this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么做？

lines.en: : Do what? All I did was repeat what you told me.
lines.zh: : 做什么？我只是重复了你告诉我的话。

lines.en: : Yeah, but did you have to do it right in front of her?
lines.zh: : 是，可你非得当着她面说吗？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor17
: ...What?
: Would it be better for her to not know your intentions, Sensei? Because the last thing I want is my beloved daughter being “led on.” I believe that phrase is applicable here, correct?
lines.zh: : 她不知道你的「企图」会更好吗，Sensei？因为我最不希望的，就是我宝贝女儿被「吊着」。我想这个词用在这儿挺贴切，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m not “leading her on” because I see her in a different light from the other girls her age. I just-
lines.zh: : 我没有「吊着她」。我只是把她看得跟同龄其他女孩不一样。我只是——

lines.en: scene returntothemanor18
: So that’s how it really is then.
lines.zh: : 原来是这么回事。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : Good night, Sensei. I apologize for misinterpreting just what sort of relationship we had.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。很抱歉，我误解了我们之间到底是种什么关系。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor19
: I will see you in the morning, Mother.
lines.zh: : 明早见，母亲。

lines.en: : Goodnight, dear.
lines.zh: : 晚安，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor6
: Whatever do you mean, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你这话是什么意思，Akira？

lines.en: : You knew she wouldn’t want to hear something like that. So why would you put both of us on the spot and just air it out like it was nothing? She was having a great day. She was in a good mood.
lines.zh: : 你明知她不想听那种话。那你干嘛要把我们俩都逼到墙角、还说得像无所谓一样？她今天本来很开心。心情正好着。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor9
: Apologies, but would it have been better for her to throw herself at you only to have you reject her? Because I’d imagine the emotional trauma that would cause would be significantly worse.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，可让她主动扑向你、再被你拒绝，那样会更好吗？因为我想象得出，那样造成的情感创伤要严重得多。

lines.en: : And I was under the impression that is what was about to happen.
lines.zh: : 而且我原以为，接下来就会发生那种事。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor7
: So, from my point of view, it’s like I rescued both of you from a terrible misunderstanding! You should be thanking me.
lines.zh: : 所以从我的角度看，我这是把你俩都从一场糟糕的误会里救了出来！你该谢我才对。

lines.en: : Not everything has to involve you, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 不是什么事都得掺你一腿，Tsubasa。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor6
: This isn’t “everything,” Akira. This is my daughter we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 这不是「什么事」，Akira。我们在说的是我女儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you know you’d be doing the same thing even if it wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 是，可你明知道，就算不是为了这个，你也会干同样的事。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor7
: Probably! But that’s not what’s happening this time, so it doesn’t apply.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧！但这次不是那样，所以这条不适用。

lines.en: : Stop interfering.
lines.zh: : 别再插手了。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor20
: Will there be consequences if I don’t?
lines.zh: : 我要是不收手，会有什么后果吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. But stop anyway.
lines.zh: : 大概没有。但反正你给我收手。

lines.en: : Shame. I like consequences.
lines.zh: : 真可惜。我喜欢「后果」。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you know that when you’ve likely never experienced any.
lines.zh: : 我挺意外你居然懂「后果」，毕竟你多半从没真正尝过。

lines.en: : We can’t all be as experienced as you, Akira. Which is why it’s your job to teach people like us.
lines.zh: : 我们不可能都像你这么「身经百战」，Akira。所以，教像我们这样的人，正是你的职责。

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s anything I can teach you that you don’t already know, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得还有什么是我能教你、而你又不知道的，Tsubasa。

lines.en: : Oh, darling. We both know that’s not true.
lines.zh: : 哦，亲爱的。咱俩都清楚那不是真的。

lines.en: : Tell me — has Touka shown you where to find our massage parlor yet?
lines.zh: : 告诉我——Touka 有没有带你去过我们那间按摩房？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor21
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : On second thought, maybe that’s a secret that would be best kept until next time.
lines.zh: : 转念一想，那个秘密或许最好留到下次再说。

lines.en: : Right now, you have a job to do.
lines.zh: : 现在，你有正事要办。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah, what else is new?
lines.zh: : 是啊，还能有什么新鲜事？

lines.en: : Tons, I’m sure! But I’m just an uninvolved passerby who doesn’t know any of it.
lines.zh: : 肯定多着呢！不过我只是个不相干的路人，什么都不知道。

lines.en: : And I’m the king of France.
lines.zh: : 那我就是法国国王。

lines.en: : Oooh! Enchanté~
Tsubasa holds her hand out to me, but I ignore it before she has the chance to pull it away.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 朝我伸出手，我没理——趁她还没来得及缩回去。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor22
But when I walk into Touka’s room to clear up the not-so-misunderstood misunderstanding, I quickly forget why I even opened the door in the first place.
lines.zh: 可当我走进 Touka 的房间、想澄清那场「其实没怎么误会的误会」时，我飞快忘了自己当初干嘛要开门。

lines.en: : Okay. Now this is just unnecessary.
lines.zh: : 行了。这真没必要。

lines.en: : Go away. I’m brooding.
lines.zh: : 走开。我在生闷气。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor23
: Why are you brooding, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你为什么生闷气，Touka？

lines.en: : Because you made me look like a fool in front of my mother! And you made me feel like a fool in front of me!
lines.zh: : 因为你让我在我母亲面前像个傻瓜！也让我在我自己面前像个傻瓜！

lines.en: : You can’t be in front of yourself. That’s not a thing.
lines.zh: : 你不可能「在自己面前」。那根本不成立。

lines.en: : Shut up! And leave me alone!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！别管我！

lines.en: : Do you want to talk or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底想不想谈？

lines.en: : No! Go away!
lines.zh: : 不想！走开！

lines.en: : Okay, well we’re going to talk anyway.
lines.zh: : 好，反正我们也要谈。

lines.en: : Guards!
lines.zh: : 来人！

lines.en: : Please don’t call the guards on me. Someone needs to take care of Ami.
lines.zh: : 求你别叫守卫来抓我。总得有人照顾 Ami。

lines.en: : Well maybe I can do it since I’m basically her grandmother now!
lines.zh: : 那也许我来照顾她，毕竟我现在差不多算她奶奶了！

lines.en: scene black
: I’m coming over there. You have approximately ten minutes to prepare yourself before I make it.
lines.zh: : 我要过去了。你大概有十分钟准备一下，等我走到。

lines.en: : Stay away! I don’t want to see you right now!
lines.zh: : 别过来！我现在不想见你！

lines.en: I obviously don’t stay away because I do want to make this right. I’m just not really sure if I’ll be able to since I’m still sort of figuring out what I want Touka to be.
lines.zh: 我显然不会「不过来」，因为我确实想把这事理顺。只是我不太确定自己办不办得到，因为连我自己都还没完全想清楚，我到底想让 Touka 成为我的什么。

lines.en: Because yes, she’s like a mother figure to me.
lines.zh: 因为，是，她对我来说确实像个「母亲般的长辈」。

lines.en: But I’ve given you enough hints about how little something like that matters.
lines.zh: 可我已经给过你足够多的暗示：那种身份根本不算数。

lines.en: I want it to. Don’t get me wrong.
lines.zh: 我希望它算数。别误会。

lines.en: But some things are just beyond fixing and I often feel like I’m one of them.
lines.zh: 可有些东西就是没法修补，而我常常觉得，我就是其中之一。

lines.en: Anyway, Touka recoils and crawls away the second I make it to her bed.
lines.zh: 总之，我一走到她床边，Touka 就缩着往后爬。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor24
Just kidding. She immediately leaps forward, knocking me over and crawling on top of me.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。她立刻往前一扑，把我撞倒，爬到我身上。

lines.en: : A mother?! Really?!
lines.zh: : 母亲？！真的假的？！

lines.en: : I understand that I’m nurturing and comforting and that you’re a misguided pervert who has likely never experienced maternal love, but come on! Seriously?! I’m just a girl! You said it yourself!
lines.zh: : 我承认我善解人意、会照顾人，也承认你是个走岔了路的色狼、多半从没感受过母爱，可是拜托！认真的吗？！我只是个女孩！你自己说的！

lines.en: : It’s complicated, okay? I don’t really get it either.
lines.zh: : 这事很复杂，好吗？连我自己都没完全搞懂。

lines.en: : Well, figure it out because that’s not a way I want to be seen!
lines.zh: : 那你就去搞懂，因为那绝不是我希望被看待的方式！

lines.en: : I’m happy to comfort you when you need it! And I understand that you need it rather frequently because you’re a misguided pervert who has likely never experienced maternal love-
lines.zh: : 你需要安慰的时候，我很乐意安慰你！我也明白你挺常需要的，因为你是个走岔了路的色狼、多半从没感受过母爱——

lines.en: : Did you really need to say that a second time?
lines.zh: : 你非得说第二遍吗？

lines.en: : But that’s just not the way I see us, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 但那不是我看我们的方式，Sensei！

lines.en: : Then how do you see us, Touka?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么看我们，Touka？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor25
: That’s not something I can say now that I know you’re picturing me as your parent!
lines.zh: : 现在我知道你在把我当你的长辈，这话我说不出口了！

lines.en: : That’s not the only way I picture you. And even if it was, it wouldn’t change anything about where this relationship can go.
lines.zh: : 我不只那么看你。而且就算我只那么看你，也不会改变这段关系能走到哪一步。

lines.en: : That is a very disturbing thing to say!
lines.zh: : 这话可太变态了！

lines.en: : Yeah. This might come as a surprise to you, but I’m pretty fucked up in a lot of very unfortunate ways.
lines.zh: : 是啊。说出来你可能不信，但在很多很不幸的方面，我脑子确实坏得不轻。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor26
: Hah...I seriously can’t believe you just let me get carried away and...flirt with you despite the way you’ve been seeing me this whole time. I called it a “date” and everything.
lines.zh: : 哈……我真不敢信，你居然就这么放任我忘乎所以地……跟你调情，尽管你这半天一直是那么看我的。我还管它叫「约会」什么的。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor27
: When did this start? Because on the beach-
lines.zh: : 这是从什么时候开始的？因为在海滩那会儿——

lines.en: : It was around Halloween, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想是万圣节前后。

lines.en: : I was feeling lost and scared and you were just...the one I looked for. And it didn’t really dawn on me why until I really started thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 那时我又迷茫又害怕，而你……恰好是我去找的那个人。而且直到我认真去想，我才明白为什么。

lines.en: : Do you know how I interpreted that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道我当时是怎么理解的吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I have my guesses.
lines.zh: : 我猜得到。

lines.en: : I thought you liked me. I thought you really did see me differently than everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我以为你喜欢我。我以为你真的把我看得跟别人不一样。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我确实。

lines.en: : But not in the right way!
lines.zh: : 但不是以对的方式！

lines.en: : I want you to see me as a woman.
lines.zh: : 我希望你把我当一个女人看。

lines.en: : The kind that’s not related to you.
lines.zh: : 那种跟「亲人」无关的女人。

lines.en: : So-
lines.zh: : 所以——

lines.en: scene returntothemanor28
: I like you.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你。

lines.en: : And maybe this is inappropriate for me to say as your student, but that’s not stopping anyone else and it just isn’t fair if I’m the only one keeping it to myself at this point.
lines.zh: : 也许作为你的学生，说这话不合适，可这又拦不住别人——而且到这地步，只有我还把话憋在心里，太不公平了。

lines.en: : If that disgusts you, fine. But it’s something you needed to know.
lines.zh: : 要是这话让你恶心，那也随你。但这是你必须知道的。

lines.en: : It doesn’t disgust me at all.
lines.zh: : 这一点都不让我恶心。

lines.en: : But you see me as a mother.
lines.zh: : 可你把我当母亲看。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’ve also been staring at your chest all day.
lines.zh: : 对，可我今天一整天也都在盯着你的胸看。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor29
: You’re probably just hungry.
lines.zh: : 你多半只是饿了。

lines.en: : I’ve also had an erection since the moment we met up pretty much.
lines.zh: : 而且从咱们碰头那一刻起，我基本就一直硬着。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor30
: You know, I had a feeling that’s what was poking me but it felt wrong to point it out.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我其实隐约觉得顶着我的就是那个，只是觉得挑明了不太好。

lines.en: : Doesn’t all of this just show that you’re not only like a matriarch, though? Like, there’s very clearly some desire at play here.
lines.zh: : 这一切不正说明你对我来说「不只是」个女家长吗？很明显，这里面掺着欲望。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor31
: But will it ever go anywhere? Or will you condemn me to the role of the one who comforts you upon your return home from someone else?
lines.zh: : 可它会有结果吗？还是说，你会把我钉死在「那个你从别人那儿回来后安慰你的人」的角色上？

lines.en: : Because I can only tell you everything will be okay so many times. I can only give you so many lap pillows and so many head rubs.
lines.zh: : 因为「一切都会好的」这种话，我能说的次数是有限的。我能给你的膝枕和摸头，也是有限的。

lines.en: : You can leave out the head rubs. Not really my thing.
lines.zh: : 摸头就算了。我不太好那口。

lines.en: : There needs to be something for me. Do you understand what I’m saying?
lines.zh: : 总得有点什么是「给我」的。你懂我在说什么吗？

lines.en: : I’m happy to give, but not without something in return.
lines.zh: : 我乐意付出，但不能毫无回报。

lines.en: : And what I want in return is far more intimate than a lap pillow.
lines.zh: : 而我想要的回报，可远比一个膝枕亲密得多。

lines.en: : Do you understand what I’m saying?
lines.zh: : 你懂我在说什么吗？

lines.en: : Do I really need to say it?
lines.zh: : 我非得说出口吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: The thing that’s poking you isn’t giving it away?
lines.zh: : 顶着我的那个东西，还不够明显吗？

lines.en: : I need to hear you say you understand.
lines.zh: : 我需要听你亲口说你懂。

lines.en: She doesn’t blink.
lines.zh: 她没眨眼。

lines.en: She doesn’t move.
lines.zh: 她没动。

lines.en: She stays perfectly still like one of the many monuments in the room and, in every single way, she’s more beautiful than all of them.
lines.zh: 她纹丝不动，像房间里那诸多雕塑中的一尊——而且无论从哪方面看，她都比它们全都美。

lines.en: To think this creature on top of me, who rivals the output of artisan hands without any effort at all, would want me is perplexing.
lines.zh: 想到压在我身上的这个造物——不费吹灰之力就能媲美能工巧匠的杰作——居然想要我，真是令人费解。

lines.en: She’s not a random girl in a random high school class. She’s a young woman who could have anyone she wants. And still it’s me.
lines.zh: 她不是某个普通高中班里的某个普通女孩。她是个想要谁就能要谁的年轻女性。可偏偏，她选的是我。

lines.en: I don’t get it.
lines.zh: 我不懂。

lines.en: I’ll never get it.
lines.zh: 我永远都不会懂。

lines.en: : I understand.
lines.zh: : 我懂。

lines.en: But I tell her I do because that’s what I’m good for — filling holes in hearts and bodies while ignoring the gaps in myself.
lines.zh: 但我还是告诉她我懂——因为我就擅长这个：填补别人心里和身体上的空洞，同时无视自己身上的缺口。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor32
: Will you condemn me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你会「定罪」我吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Or will you make me grovel?
lines.zh: : 还是会让我「赔罪」？

lines.en: : Would you actually grovel for me?
lines.zh: : 你真愿意为我低声下气？

lines.en: scene returntothemanor33
: If it works, maybe. I’ve never tried before.
lines.zh: : 如果管用的话，也许。我以前从没试过。

lines.en: : You like me that much, huh?
lines.zh: : 你还真挺喜欢我的嘛。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor34
: I have very poor taste in men, apparently.
lines.zh: : 显然，我看男人的眼光差得很。

lines.en: : You really do.
lines.zh: : 确实差。

lines.en: : But no...
lines.zh: : 不过，不……

lines.en: : I won’t condemn you.
lines.zh: : 我不会「定罪」你。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor35

lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : I can’t change the way I see you.
lines.zh: : 我改变不了自己看你的方式。

lines.en: : But I also can’t deny the fact that I want to fuck your brains out.
lines.zh: : 可我也没法否认，我想把你操得神志不清。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor36
: Oh my.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: : That was...forward.
lines.zh: : 这话……可真直接。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you asked.
lines.zh: : 是啊……谁让你问了。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor37
: I did, didn’t I?...
lines.zh: : 我确实问了，对吧？……

lines.en: : I also...
lines.zh: : 我也……

lines.en: : Would like for you to do that...
lines.zh: : 也想让你那么做……

lines.en: scene returntothemanor38
: N-Not right now, though! Eventually!
lines.zh: : 不——不是现在！是以后！

lines.en: : This is all...happening really fast and...
lines.zh: : 这一切……发生得太快了，而且……

lines.en: : I will admit that I’m still rather turned off by the fact that you’d do such a thing with someone you’re openly admitting to viewing as a mother figure. Even if the figure in question is a teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 我得承认，想到你要跟一个你公开承认「视作母亲般长辈」的人做那种事，我还是挺倒胃口的。哪怕这个「长辈」是个十几岁的女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah. I can’t say I really blame you for that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这点我真没法怪你。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor34
: So...what do we do now? Mother is bound to ask what transpired in here when I see her in the morning.
lines.zh: : 那……我们现在怎么办？明早我一见母亲，她肯定会问这屋里发生了什么。

lines.en: : If you really want to fuck with her, just tell her we had sex.
lines.zh: : 你要真想气她，就直接跟她说我们做爱了。

lines.en: scene returntothemanor39
: Sensei! I couldn’t possibly-
lines.zh: : Sensei！我怎么可能——

lines.en: : Stop.
lines.zh: : 打住。

lines.en: scene black
: Call me Akira from now on.
lines.zh: : 从现在起，叫我 Akira。

lines.en: $ toukaspring2 = True
$ touka_love += 1
scene bedroom_night
Touka and I decided it would be best to keep our conversation confidential from Tsubasa, but I can only guess how well that will work.
lines.zh: Touka 和我决定，最好别让 Tsubasa 知道我们的谈话内容——不过这事能瞒多久，我只能猜。

lines.en: I’m sure she’ll find out sooner or later.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她迟早会发现。

lines.en: And I’m sure she’ll just try to get herself involved again once she does.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，她一发现，又会想办法掺和进来。

lines.en: So yeah, that could be really problematic given the nature of our relationship and what the future holds.
lines.zh: 所以，是啊——考虑到我们关系的性质和未来走向，这可能会很麻烦。

lines.en: But I’m trying to think of the positives.
lines.zh: 但我在尽量往好处想。

lines.en: scene black
And the positives in this case sound very exciting.
lines.zh: 而这事儿的「好处」，听着就让人兴奋。

lines.en: : Come to bed, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: : 上床吧，Aki 君。

lines.en: Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!
lines.zh: Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！
